QuestInfo.name: [Pink Bean] Big Bean, Little Beans
QuestInfo.0: He says Mini Beans are always around Pink Bean. They are incomplete beings, for they only have pieces of the true bean's intelligence, strength, appearance, and such. And what you need is 5 Giant Ribs...? He says you can trade the Developer's Letter from the Anniversary festival for the Giant Ribs.
QuestInfo.1: Collect and trade Developer's Letters from the Anniversary festival area for 5 Giant Ribs.
QuestInfo.2:
You got all the Giant Ribs you need... hopefully. All there is left to do is to lure out the Mini Beans!

#rCaution!
You cannot complete the [Pink Bean] quest if you discard your #i2432706#  #t2432706# items.
Collect 1 Developer's Letter to trade to Manager Mush for the Giant Ribs.

default.0: I'm guessing you haven't collected all the #b#i2432706# #t2432706##k items yet. You just have to trade in 5 of your Developer's Letters!
